wholePhysicalScope: OpenStreetMap archaeological relation 8338022 maps the outer ruin and the excavated court independently. The renderer opening follows the inner court with a narrow overlap into the modeled stone walls. The surrounding original elevation field is preserved.
lodDetails: All four levels retain the sunken paved court, stone wall ring, four door recesses and stepped crown. Near levels refine the staggered dry stonework and floor paving.
limitations: The March 2025 excavated ruins are represented as found. The precise depth and wall-top elevations are approximate.
The courtyard opening follows the mapped excavation with a small overlap into the stone. The original elevation field remains unchanged.
Roof reconstruction, underground passages, adjacent ruins and uncertain ancient details are outside this model.
